    The degreewise split exact structure on cochain complexes #

    Let C be an additive category. A short complex of cochain complexes over C is a degreewise split conflation when it is split exact in every degree, not necessarily compatibly with the differentials. These conflations form a Quillen exact structure on CochainComplex C ℤ (Keller, Chain complexes and stable categories, Section 1). No limits or colimits are assumed in C: the kernels, cokernels, pushouts and pullbacks required by the axioms exist degreewise because the sequences split, and are assembled into complexes by the degreewise (co)limits of HomologicalComplex.

    Split short exact sequences in an additive category #

    • splitComp, splitCompDeflation: composites of split monomorphisms (resp. split epimorphisms) with split cokernels (resp. kernels) again have split cokernels (resp. kernels).
    • isPushout_split, isPullback_split: the pushout of a split monomorphism and the pullback of a split epimorphism, as biproducts.
